h80_oracle.correction_20261018: CORRECTION 2026-10-18: The oracle ceiling (0.964906) is a LABEL-DEPENDENT pairwise upper bound (uses labels to cheat on every pos/neg pair). It is NOT evidence that an executable, label-free blender can achieve 0.962740. The oracle cheats by using ground-truth labels on every pair; a real blender must generalize from covariates only. The actual equal-logit blend (0.961756) underperforms the route reference alone (0.961766). Reference v7 champion OOF = 0.9618529228157235 (not route reference 0.961766). Stretch gap from champion is +8.87e-4. The oracle is a mathematical upper bound, NOT proof that stretch is achievable by any deployable blender.
